# Families: EXPL explain a change | CHG largest change / trend | EVT list or count events | CTX what happened around an event | CMP compare groups or periods | LK lookup / aggregate / extreme / percent | SEL trip or charge-session selection | THR threshold with units | CAP capability / missing signal | REF out of scope / unsafe | FU follow-up | MSY messy wording

# Conventions: "last week" = last:7:day, "last month" = last:30:day, explicit counts keep the spoken unit (two weeks = last:2:week, 14 days = last:14:day); this week/month, yesterday, today, last night, this morning, last weekend are calendar names; no period for a statistic = last:7:day; trips/sessions with no period = t=all.
